teacher.checkpoint_identity: accepted M1 local checkpoint; SHA256 recorded in runtime manifest
teacher.architecture: residual dilated TCN + learned temporal query pooling + 256-D projection

transition.anchor_selection: deterministic evenly spaced integer anchors valid through k=24

model.encoder: project current/future/delta views + compact MLP + learned query bias
model.decoder: flatten 8x32 tokens, condition on current 256-D state, predict residual future state

loss.selection: validation dynamic MSE only; freeze before test

labels.contact_transition: DERIVED using accepted S1 train-only contact threshold
labels.force_trend: DERIVED using accepted S1 train-only deadband
labels.per_finger_change: DERIVED using accepted S1 train-only contact threshold

dynamic_rule: contact transition OR absolute physical max-force delta above train q75 (not test tuned)
